Lemma
[Duhamel's principle on a closed manifold] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0355, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0356 1. ch26:26.1\group Evolving Heat Kernels

If $A,B$ are $C^2$ in space and $C^1$ in time on a closed evolving manifold, then \[ \int _{\tau _1}^{\tau _2}\! \int _{\mathcal M} ((LA)B-A(L^*B))\, d\mu _{g(\tau )}d\tau =\int _{\mathcal M}AB\, d\mu _{g(\tau _2)} -\int _{\mathcal M}AB\, d\mu _{g(\tau _1)}. \]
Proof

\sketch Expand $L,L^*$, use the evolution of the volume form, and integrate the two Laplacian terms by parts. The integrand becomes $\frac d{d\tau }\int _{\mathcal M}AB\, d\mu _{g(\tau )}$.

□
